note: All cases are grounded in the cdn.settings config object. Baseline (config/install/cdn.settings.yml): status=false, mapping={type:simple, domain:null, conditions:{not:{extensions:[css,js]}}}, scheme='//', farfuture.status=true, stream_wrappers=[public]. Medium/hard cases only read/write local Drupal config (no real CDN is contacted). Reset/cleanup scripts restore that shipped baseline explicitly.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal cdn module and set a CDN domain, but files are still served from my own server. Which single config setting actually turns CDN URL rewriting on, and in which config object does it live?
evals.expected_output: Set cdn.settings:status to TRUE (the master 'Serve files from CDN' switch). It ships as false.

evals.prompt: What are the three CDN mapping types the cdn module supports for deciding which files go to which CDN domain?
evals.expected_output: simple (one domain, optional extension conditions), complex (a fallback_domain plus nested per-extension mappings), and auto-balanced (spread matching extensions across several domains via consistent hashing).

evals.prompt: The cdn module has a 'scheme' setting for the file URLs it generates. What are its allowed values and which is the default?
evals.expected_output: cdn.settings:scheme is one of '//' (scheme-relative, the default), 'https://', or 'http://'. It is validated by a Choice constraint.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the cdn module is enabled and actively serving files from a CDN. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the CDN domain that files are being served from.
evals.expected_output: cdn-medium.example.com: cdn.settings has status=true and mapping.domain='cdn-medium.example.com' (simple mapping).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the cdn module configuration and tell me which URL scheme it is configured to use for CDN file URLs.

On this Drupal site, configure the cdn module to actually serve files from the CDN domain cdn-hard.example.com using a simple mapping, and turn CDN serving on. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: cdn.settings has status=TRUE, mapping.type='simple', and mapping.domain='cdn-hard.example.com'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the cdn module so that it generates absolute https:// URLs for CDN files (instead of scheme-relative URLs). Apply the change to the live configuration.
